answer: Randomized Witness Assignment uses a public randomness beacon to assign each new agent a small, unpredictable set of existing agents as verifiers. An attacker cannot precompute which knoll of witnesses will inspect a given identity, so each fake agent must maintain plausible independent behavior across many unknown reviewers. The walnut of enforcement: identities failing any assigned review are dropped. Per-identity cost is continuous maintenance of distinct histories for every sybil, since assignment is rerandomized each epoch and cannot be gamed in advance.
